info.title: Factory Workspace API
info.description: AGENT CHANGE POLICY: Never change anything in this file without first consulting the user and obtaining explicit approval for the proposed changes. This includes additions, removals, renames, constraints, annotations, formatting and automated rewrites. Do not infer approval from a broader implementation task. Loaded Factory reads and revision-checked Protobuf edits. Mutations require X-Factory-Client: web and validate a candidate root before publication.

get.summary: Subscribe to live published Factory revision changes
get.description: Read-only SSE using the existing loopback Host/Origin policy. Initial factory.ready and subsequent factory.changed frames each contain JSON {revision: <whole-root SHA-256>}. Registration and baseline capture are atomic with publication. At most 32 connections and 32 queued revisions per receiver; lag or shutdown closes the stream. Reconnect establishes a fresh baseline and clients reread current state. Live-only: no event IDs, Last-Event-ID replay, polling or filesystem watcher. Keepalive comments carry no change event. No domain payloads or credentials are included.

200.description: Live event stream; cancellation releases the subscription

SecretOperationResult.description: Metadata, new revision and next challenge; reveal contains encrypted response, never plaintext. Activation invalidates project sessions.

NotFound.description: Path is not present in the loaded Factory

Forbidden.description: Host, Origin or cross-site boundary rejected; empty body

SecretOperation.description: Trusted loopback prototype; accepted RSA timing risk. RSA-OAEP SHA256 label factory/secretmgr/transport/v1 wraps a fresh AES256 key. AES-GCM AAD is UTF8 JSON array [factory/secretmgr/request/v1,operation,project,revision,challenge,name,path]. Reveal response uses the same transport key and AAD with /reply appended. Challenges are single-use and recovered via status on errors. No plaintext/password fields. Activation plaintext is the new password; set plaintext is the value; other operations encrypt an empty payload.

FactoryDomain.description: Generated DomainFactory payload from the domain catalog. Identifies the persistent root, not a project or a load snapshot.

FactoryRecord.description: Factory root domain and its common RecordEnvelope header. Lifecycle fields exist only in .factory.

DomainRecord.description: domain_type selects the identically named generated schema in domaintypes.json. Domain payloads are validated during Factory construction.

DependencyPaths.description: Generic explicit prerequisites for Factory records. Index zero must equal the canonical self record directory. Remaining paths must reference unique, existing non-parent records. Self is not a graph edge. DomainAgent persona and skills supply additional derived edges; do not duplicate them here. Domain payloads must not contain depends_on; retired slug dependencies require explicit migration.

RecordHeader.description: Persisted record metadata. Legacy records can lack depends_on until explicit migration; reads never invent it. Writes accept DependencyHeader, not identity fields.

derived_key.description: Sensitive base64-encoded 32-byte PBKDF2 result. Never send through an AI tool or logs.

.factory.description: Must exactly match the owning record dependency list; update the record explicitly before editing a legacy narrative.
